:::{.callout-warning}
# Information
If you do all exercises on HPC2N, there is no need to install WSL2 on your own computer. You can still do it if you want to try the exercises on your own computer. Just note that we might not be able to support if things don't work.
:::

During this course we will learn to use the linux command line and programs to analyze data. Many of the programs we will use do not work on Windows, but must run on a linux based system. For those of you on a Mac or a linux, you already have a linux based system built in, with a command prompt you can use. For Windows users, we will install Windows subsystems for linux (WSL2). So if you are on Windows, follow the below instructions.

## Prerequisites
You must be running Windows 10 version 2004 and higher (Build 19041 and higher) or Windows 11.

## Installation
Follow the steps outlined in the official documentation <a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/wsl/install" target="_blank">here</a>.

## Verify version
Verify that you have the correct version installed by typing this command in Windows Command Prompt or PowerShell:

```{}
wsl -l -v
```
